title: Felt Piano at 4AM
description: A dreamy UK garage two-step that slow-burns from a lone felt piano into a soulful 2-step shuffle. Broken AkaiLinn kicks and swung hats carry a soft sub bass while the piano chords drift up the keyboard, leaving wide-open pockets for a sung-rap hook.
code:
setcpm(143/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("piano").room(0.5).gain(0.55).lpf(900)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.0).lpf(1400),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("piano").room(0.45).gain(0.58).lpf(1200)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.1),
    s("~ hh ~ hh").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    s("~ cp").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.6),
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sine").gain(0.6).lpf(420),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.1),
    s("hh*4").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.45).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2),
    s("~ cp").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.62),
    note("<c2 ab1 eb2 g1>").s("sine").gain(0.62).lpf(520),
    note("<[eb3,g3,c4] [c3,eb3,ab3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.6).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(1200, 3000))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,c4] [c3,eb3,ab3]>").s("piano").room(0.6).gain(0.6),
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sine").gain(0.5).lpf(360).room(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.1).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh*4").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.5).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ oh ~ ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    s("~ cp").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.65),
    note("<c2 ab1 eb2 g1>").s("sine").gain(0.62).lpf(700),
    note("<[eb3,g3,c4] [c3,eb3,ab3] [f3,ab3,c4] [g3,bb3,d4]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.6).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.9).lpf(900),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("piano").room(0.6).gain(0.55).lpf(1000)
  )]
)
